get_lang_tok_mbart: get a language token string in mbart style like [en] for a given language code
get_lang_tok_multilingual: get a language token string in multilingual style like __en__ for a given language code
get_lang_tok_dae_spec: get a language token with a dae spec suffix appended to the language code
augment_dictionary_mbart: augment a fairseq dictionary with mbart style language tokens for a list of languages
augment_dictionary_multilingual: augment a fairseq dictionary with multilingual style language tokens and an optional mask symbol
